title: Since 1957: Washington Auto Carriage & Meyer Products
body_markdown:
For 100 years, Meyer Products has helped customers take on winter with dependable snow removal equipment. Along the way, the company has built lasting relationships with dealers who share that commitment to quality and[service](https://www.aebi-schmidt.com/en/products-solutions/maintenance-service/) .


In Spokane Valley, Washington (USA), Washington Auto Carriage is one of those partners, proudly selling Meyer snowplows and equipment since 1957. Their longstanding partnership represents more than two-thirds of Meyer’s century-long history.


### **A Partnership Built on Dependability**


When asked what has kept Washington Auto Carriage selling Meyer products for so many years, the answer comes down to a few things that matter to dealers and customers alike: great customer service, product availability, competitive pricing, and support after the sale.


That commitment to dependability has been especially meaningful as Meyer celebrates its 100th anniversary. For Washington Auto Carriage, longevity means knowing parts and equipment will be available when needed, along with a manufacturer that stands behind its products when warranty issues arise.


For 69 years, Washington Auto Carriage has proudly promoted parts and service to Meyer customers across the region. Pictured: early 2000’s Lot Pro.


Meyer Lot Pro has been Washington Auto’s most popular plow on display outside in the early 2000’s.


### **Honoring the Classics While Looking Ahead**


Over the years, Meyer has continued to evolve alongside the trucks and customers its products serve. Washington Auto Carriage has seen that evolution firsthand, from the classic Meyer snowplows that built a loyal following today's updated equipment and technology. Many classic model plows are still moving snow in the Spokane region.


The Meyer Lot Pro is the dealership's most popular snowplow, reflecting the continued demand for equipment that meets the needs of today's operators. Meyer's ongoing updates to hydraulic systems, redesigned pumps, and attachment solutions help keep pace with changing truck technology.


For Washington Auto Carriage, it's that combination of proven performance and continued innovation that makes the Meyer name relevant today.


### **Going Beyond the Sale**


A big part of Washington Auto Carriage's success comes from its commitment to helping customers get the most out of their equipment.


Years ago, the dealership hosted snowplow clinics, drawing anywhere from 80 to 100 attendees. These events gave snow equipment operators hands-on instruction on operating and maintaining their plows. The dealership even gave away a snowplow at the clinics, helping build a strong and lasting customer base along the way.


That same commitment to customer education continues today, in a more personalized format.


“When a customer purchases a Meyer V-plow or straight-blade plow, we take the time to walk them through their new equipment,” notes the Washington Auto Sales Staff. “We demonstrate how to operate the plow, explain the Hands-Free system and quick-disconnect features, and share tips for proper off-season storage, including the use of dielectric grease. Most importantly, we make sure customers have an opportunity to ask questions and feel confident using their new equipment.”


By helping customers understand, maintain, and care for their equipment, Washington Auto Carriage builds relationships that last long after the initial purchase.


Washington Auto Carriage Snowplow Clinics provided hands-on instruction while building customer relationships, today it’s a more personalized approach. Outdoor display shown late 90’s.


Today, Washington Auto Carriage continues to champion Meyer Products and deliver the exceptional support that has made this partnership strong for more than half of Meyer’s 100-year history.


### **100 Years of Meyer. 70 Years of Partnership.**


Meyer's 100-year anniversary is an opportunity to celebrate the products, people, and partnerships that have helped shape the company over the decades. For Washington Auto Carriage, it's also a reminder of the value of working with a manufacturer that remains committed to its dealers.


After 7 decades, appreciation flows both ways.


We're proud to celebrate this longstanding partnership and grateful to have Washington Auto Carriage as part of the Meyer story. Here's to the dealers who help keep our legacy moving forward, one winter at a time.


Looking for equipment in the Spokane, Washington area?[Washington Auto Carriage](https://www.washingtonautocarriage.com/) .
